Bedford, Texas6 contributions

Great Food. Wow!!
Apr 2026 • Family
One of the Bell men at the Sheraton Grand Opera Hotel suggested El Gaucho. It was a 10 to 15 minute walk from the hotel. It was around 2PM local time and not busy, our advantage. We ordered the Beef burger and told the waiter we would split it. When our food came it was on 2 plates with the fries also split between us, a nice surprise. Wow, the taste was wonderful; cooked medium rare. The fries were hot. El Gaucho was a great experience, great service, great food. If we return to Ho Chi Minh City El Gaucho will be a place we will eat.
